Pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 and in accordance with the Policy on Code of Conduct for Regulating, Monitoring & Reporting of Trades and Prevention of Insider Trading of the Company, the Trading Window for dealing in securities/shares of Transindia Real Estate Limited will remain closed for Insiders, Designated Persons and their immediate relatives with effect from Thursday, October 01, 2026, till the completion of 48 hours after the declaration of Un-audited (Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Accordingly, Insiders, Designated Persons of the Company and their immediate relatives are advised not to trade (buy, sell or pledge, etc.) in the securities/shares of the Company during the aforesaid period of closure of the Trading Window. The Board Meeting date for consideration and approval of above mentioned shall be intimated in due course.
We hereby submit investor presentation for FY 2026.
